headline: Opposition Leader Faces Investigation After Allegedly Failing to Hum Along to Vande Mataram
body:
A national political party has been forced to issue a formal clarification after a parliamentary panel launched a preliminary inquiry into whether a senior opposition leader failed to achieve the mandatory decibel level while humming during a recent Vande Mataram rendition. The controversy erupted after social media analysts claimed the leader’s lips moved at a tempo 0.4 seconds slower than the official government-sanctioned backing track.

“We have submitted a 400-page dossier containing audio spectrograms and lip-sync analysis to prove that the leader was, in fact, humming in a frequency that only dogs and highly trained nationalists can hear,” said party spokesperson Ramesh Varma. “The accusation that she was merely contemplating her grocery list during the anthem is a malicious fabrication aimed at distracting from our actual policy debates.”

To prevent further scrutiny, the party has announced that all future public events will require attendees to wear throat-mounted microphones that transmit their humming performance directly to a centralized server in Delhi. The government has welcomed the proposal, suggesting that a 'Patriotic Pitch' score should now be included in all candidates' annual performance appraisals alongside their voter turnout statistics.
caption: New guidelines suggest that standard singing is no longer sufficient; citizens must now provide a digital humming certificate to prove their devotion. #VandeMataram #Politics #HummingPolicy #India (satire)

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 0 excels by grounding an absurd premise in plausible administrative bureaucracy, creating a coherent narrative arc from the investigation to the proposed policy solution. Its specific details, such as the 400-page dossier and the throat-mounted microphone requirement, elevate the satire into a clever commentary on performative patriotism that feels both imaginative and affectionately ribbing rather than merely cynical.
